Comment: Transform chain: Silver, then the gate, then Gold only if the gate passes. Emails only on a blocked gate or a crashed step. ADR-0001. Rendered by Terraform templatefile(); tested offline by tests/test_state_machine.py.

Silver.Comment: Run the Bronze->Silver Glue job and wait for it to finish (.sync), so the gate never checks a half-written Silver.

Retry.Comment: Bug #16: Glue reports a run finished seconds before it frees the job's single run slot. Seen in production on 2026-11-11 (M-061).

Gate.Comment: Invoke the DQ gate. Keep only the fields the chain needs, under $.gate.

Retry.Comment: Lambda service hiccups only. A gate that raised (e.g. an Athena timeout) is caught below and emailed, not retried.

GatePassed.Comment: The only road into Gold. Anything other than an explicit pass is a block.

Gold.Comment: Run the Silver->Gold Glue job (full rebuild) and wait for it to finish.

SilverFailed.Comment: Record which step failed, so the email can name it.

AlertGateBlocked.Comment: One email naming the blocking checks. Observed values live in gold/dq_results under the gate run id.

Parameters.Subject: [crypto-anomaly] Gate blocked the run - Gold not built

AlertStepFailed.Comment: One email naming the step that crashed or timed out, with its error.

Parameters.Subject: [crypto-anomaly] Transform run failed

GateBlocked.Cause: The gate reported a blocking failure, so Gold was not built. See $.gate.blocking_failures in the execution history and gold/dq_results.

RunFailed.Cause: A step failed and was not retried. The alert email names the step and its error.
